basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 26-year-old Pokémon enthusiast from Michigan. I'm a big fan of gaming, especially anything related to Pokémon or medieval-themed games like Bannerlord. I spend my weekdays working as a junior software developer, but weekends are for gaming and exploring local parks to catch Pokémon. When I'm not on my computer, I'm probably out with friends or trying out new coffee shops. I usually hop online in the evenings. Currently, I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to pursue my hobbies. I'm also starting to experiment with space bucket gardening, which is a fun new challenge!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having completed my degree at a local university. I developed a passion for coding through self-teaching and online courses. My gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and discussing games online, along with some community-organized workshops.
